rice.selection_rationale: Strong linear & seasonal trend capture. 1-step MAPE: 3.46% (AR) vs 3.66% (XGBoost). XGBoost supports non-linear state interactions.
rice.state_support: 24 states supported with dedicated state encoders

wheat.selection_rationale: Lowest 30-step recursive forecast error (MAE ₹116.90 vs AR ₹204.09). Superior multi-step trend stability.
wheat.state_support: 18 states supported with dedicated state encoders

maize.selection_rationale: Consistent multi-horizon performance across Kharif and Rabi seasons. 1-step MAPE: 3.26% (AR) vs 3.62% (XGBoost).
maize.state_support: 20 states supported with dedicated state encoders

onion.selection_rationale: State-Aware XGBoost significantly outperforms linear models on extreme non-linear supply/harvest shocks (1-step MAPE 10.79% vs Naive 90.93% and AR 82.07%).
onion.state_support: 30 states supported with dedicated state encoders

potato.selection_rationale: While Naive persistence has lower 1-step error due to daily price stickiness (₹142), it cannot forecast 30-day seasonal harvest dips (flat line). XGBoost achieves ₹280 MAE on 30-day recursive forecast vs AR ₹586.
potato.state_support: 30 states supported with dedicated state encoders
